question: Can the exact 1589 Yueling Tongkao Dahan/Yushui fingerprint material be physically source-labeled to 通書, and if so what does that citation authorize about the unidentified common source?

direct_layout_collation.method: Direct visual collation of source-bound rendered physical pages; OCR/transcription not used for final glyph or layout adjudication.

philological_adjudication.label: 通書
philological_adjudication.safe_claim: The 1589 compiler physically marks the target day/night material with the generic source label 通書. This materially strengthens a Tongshu-source-family transmission hypothesis but does not identify which Tongshu title, recension, edition, or date supplied it.

comparison_and_directionality.reason_for_last_firewall: The physically reviewed 1455/coarse Tongshu branch has Xiazhi 60/40 whereas exact Sanming 1578 has 59/41; generic label identity cannot erase that numeric mismatch.
comparison_and_directionality.next_source_search_narrowing: Prioritize pre-1578 Tongshu/almanac recensions and upstream Tongshu compilation lines that could carry the exact 十三後 / 後四日 fingerprint; do not treat all works labeled 通書 as one table.
